steps.caption: Posts & photos
steps.narration: Job photos go on the Google listing filed by photo category. Here is how to pick and file them.

steps.caption: Upload photos
steps.narration: Upload photos takes up to one hundred at a time, fifteen megabytes each.

steps.caption: Tick a photo
steps.narration: Or tick photos already in the media library.

steps.caption: Tick another
steps.narration: Tick as many as you want.

steps.value: Front elevation after a full tear-off and new architectural shingles in Highland.
steps.caption: Caption
steps.narration: Each ticked photo gets a caption box. Type what the photo shows.

steps.caption: Photo category
steps.narration: Photo category is Google's own list: exterior, interior, at work, teams, cover and more.

steps.caption: At work
steps.narration: Choose at work for crew photos from the job.

steps.caption: Schedule and approve
steps.narration: Under Schedule and approve, nothing goes to Google until you approve.

steps.caption: Approve & queue photos
steps.narration: Approve and queue photos queues one item per ticked photo, in the category you chose.

steps.caption: Photo items in the queue
steps.narration: Queued photos then show in Calendar, queue and history as photo items, with their time and status.

youtube.title: How to file job photos by Google category | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: How to pick job photos for a Google Business Profile in ConstructHUB: upload or tick photos from the media library, caption each one, choose a Google photo category such as exterior, interior, at work or teams, and approve them for the queue.
